catches: Only claim this bonus if you were ALREADY going to spend $12,000 in six months — never spend extra to chase a bonus.
The $895 annual fee eats the bonus: even at the max offer the year-one net is ~$855 (175,000 pts at ~1 cent each minus $895), and most applicants are offered less than 175,000 points.

The advertised number is 'as high as' 175,000 — your actual offer is revealed during the application, and it may be lower; Amex's page says 'Welcome offers vary and you may not be eligible for an offer.'
Applying triggers a hard credit inquiry.
Once-per-lifetime rule: you can only ever earn the Platinum Card welcome bonus once — if you have or have had this card, you are not eligible.

Amex runs a bonus-eligibility check during the application ('popup jail'): if their system flags you (too many cards opened/closed, prior bonus abuse), you get a pop-up saying you won't get the welcome offer and can withdraw before the hard inquiry.
Carrying a balance at ~20%+ APR wipes out the bonus instantly — pay in full every month.
Returned purchases, fees, and cash equivalents don't count toward the $12,000 spend threshold.

steps: Open the official Amex page https://www.americanexpress.com/us/credit-cards/card/platinum/ and start the application — do not apply from an affiliate link that shows different terms.

During the application, Amex tells you your exact personal offer amount before you accept — if it is lower than 175,000 points or shows a no-bonus pop-up, withdraw the application before the hard inquiry.
If approved and you accept, spend $12,000 on purchases you were already planning within the first 6 months of Card Membership (about $2,000/month of normal spending).
Pay the balance in full every month — carrying a balance at ~20%+ APR destroys the bonus value.
Keep the account open and in good standing; the bonus posts 8-12 weeks after you hit the spend threshold.
Redeem the points for travel (Amex Travel or airline/hotel transfer partners) to get roughly 1 cent or more per point, comfortably above the $895 fee only if you got a large offer.
timing: Bonus Membership Rewards points are credited 8-12 weeks after you meet the $12,000 spend threshold.
